feedback: Written before this candidate races. The candidate is the ±0.03 m, 16 mm, y = 0.04 row, the best-raced geometry at 69.46 (iteration 3, reproduced in iterations 5 to 7). I have held kp 1.2, kd 0.4 and base_speed 1.1. Iteration 4 (61.49) changed kp to 1.0 and widened the row to ±0.04 m in the same race, and progress fell on the s-bend (0.210 to 0.160) and oval (0.184 to 0.170) with line loss unchanged at 1.0. So the ±0.04 m row has still not been tested at kp 1.2 alone. Do not expect a new best from this candidate. When the race reports, check whether line loss and max error match iteration 3 (max error near 0.062 m, line loss 1.0 to 1.1 per run). If they do, the next geometry step is the isolating ±0.04 m test at kp 1.2, which is your planned iteration 10 test.
requested_changes: Hold sensor_positions at x = -0.03 to 0.03 in 0.015 m steps, y = 0.04, sensor_size 0.016, for this race, so the controller is judged on the geometry it was tuned for.
Next iteration, race ±0.04 m at 16 mm with y = 0.04 at kp 1.2 and kd 0.4 to isolate the widening from the gain change that confounded iteration 4.
If s-bend steering oscillation stays at 0.16 or above with the ±0.03 m row, try sensor_size 0.012 at the same ±0.03 m positions to test whether 16 mm footprint noise is the cause.
